content: Abi yacno yuedanquidquio icquin Moises dëniacquid Esuquidistu

Adec matses icsaid bedshunash abided cuidadaid Esuquidistu tantiaquido aton shubun icquido nec. Adquid icquin Nuquin Papan, Ëbi chuibeneta, cashumbic adembidi ambi matses chuibanec ëbëd onquequid dapa icoata caid Esuquidistu nec, quequin aidquio tantiaquionona.
Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen chieshenquiocquin naquido Nuquin Papan shubun icquido abi tantiaquido iquendac, quequin Moisesën chuided-chuidedampicpaden Esuquidistun adomboembidi chuibampanëdash.
Aidi Abiambo Yampid yec, Ëbi tantiaquido con shubun icquido nendac, Esuquidistu quiacpadec adecbidi adtiapimbo Moises icoapampic.
Nëidted con shubun ëbëdi tabadendac, quequid shubu icbo nec. Aden Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen aton shubun icquido bëdambocquid icmequid Esuquidistu nec.
Nuquin Papan shubun icquid ambi namiaidquio Moises icquin Nuquin Papan: Matses con shubun icquido icmequid iquendac, quequin min matses chuita, cacpadomboen chuiquid Moises icpampic.

Esuquidistu Nuquin Papan Madombo yampidquio aton Papan shubun icquid icquin aton Papan Moises chuimiampicpaden aton shubun icquido icmepanëdash. Aidën shubun icquid nebi, queshun chieshenquiocquin cainquidquio aton shubun icquidquio nuqui nendac.
Aton shubun tabadnuequid naden Nuquin Papan Mayanën ambi chiaid mibi bëdamboen tantiamenuen chieque. Tantiata:

content.text: “Nëbimbobi Nuquin Papan chiaid chieshënenquio yec tabadta.
Equipito yacnoësh cuëte nibëdacno capuquin tsusedpabon,
¿Nuquibëdida Nuquin Papa iqueque? Tantiabono, queshun ambi chiaid chieshëmpampicpaden chieshënenda.
Cuëte nibëdacno seta 40ted matamec capucuenequin tsusedpabon Nuquin Papan nadatiambocquin naded-nadedsho isquimbi
¿Ambi chiaid niacshoda Nuquin Papan ëbi cuidpeba?
Ëmbi chiaid chieshënec ambibi tantiacpadequi icsadenepampic.
Adquid icsho isun chushcain: Ëmbi abitedi uabanquin nainash
ëbi tabadacno aidtedi puduedmenquio iquembi, quequin chiacpadomboen naindambi. Abimbo caimbi,”

content: quequin Nuquin Papan isadaidbo chiampid nec.
Abiambo Yampid Nuquin Papa abi iquec, quequin tantiash cuëshëdchitomane queshun tantiadonequiota.
Nuquin Papan chiacpadquiec tabadnuna, quec badiadquidën-badiadquidënquiec chuinanec onqueta ma adoac icsamianquidën chiac Nuquin Papan chiaid chieshënenquiocpanuna.
Esusbëd icquid nebi, quiondacpaden tantiadenequin caimbudec aton matses yec Esus yacno nidanetequidquio mibi nendac.
Nuquin Papan chiampid utsitsen chuinu. Tantia:

content.text: “Nëbimbobi Nuquin Papan chiaid tantesa uampicpaden tantesa uainda.”

content: ¿Tsuntsin Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiashun chieshëmpampic? ¿Equipito yacnoshon bëyucanquin Moisesën buanaido Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiash chieshquido yanenquioda icpampic?
¿Tsutsibidi seta 40ted matamec chiesho isash Nuquin Papa aidtedbidi seta matamec nëishted-nëishtedpampic? Adoac ¿Cuëte nibëdacnoësh icsaquidtedi unësbudnenquioda icpampic?
¿Abitedi uabanquin nainash ëbi tabadacno puduedmenquio iquembi, quequin tsutsi Nuquin Papan chuipampic? ¿Ambi chiaid chieshënquid Nuquin Papan chienquioda icpampic?
Ai, tsusedpabon Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiash, Bëdambo iqueque. Adonona, queboedombi, Nuqui nabocpadomboen nanuna, quequin ambi chiaid chieshënsho Nuquin Papan abi yacno puduedmetiapimbo icpampic.
